structure.guhs.steigerhuisje.tooltip: A cottage with a dock on the Deep Guh Sea. This is where the story of Sniff Island begins
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.uitleg: Your little brother or sister is sick and only the healing flower can help. On Sniff Island you're a dog and you learn to sniff, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.stap.1: Choose your dog and set sail
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.0: Look for a dock cottage by the water. Your Super Compass (My Story) shows the way.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.0: A dock cottage on a Deep Guh Sea in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.1: Little Wobble is sick and Papa has been gone for weeks. Go to the sickbed in the cottage. Then choose your dog and your buddy with Captain Saltsnout, and sail out onto the water with him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.1: The dock cottage: the sickbed in the cottage, the captain at the end of the dock
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.2: You're a dog! Wendy Wagtail found you on the beach and has run on ahead. Follow the path to Sniffville and talk to her at the beach gate.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.3: Tell Doctor Plasterpaw what's going on at home. His office is the white house with the red cross, by the square.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4: Master Trufflenose will teach you to sniff. Go through the gate on the north side of the square to the meadow and talk to him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.5: All sorts of things are toppling over in the square, but nobody sees who's doing it. Go have a look by the well.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.6: The villagers have mislaid all sorts of things. Talk to the baker, the fisher, the teacher, Granny, the gardener or Little Droolball. With every good deed your buddy's little tree grows.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.7: The little tree is a young tree now: your nose is ready. Talk to Master Trufflenose in the meadow.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.8: You've got your diploma: you're a Sniff Pup! Your buddy wants to show you something by the little tree, on the little hill in the meadow.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.klaar: You're a real Sniff Pup and you have a trace of Papa. With the Guhstation you can go back to the island whenever you like. To be continued, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.thuis: The story continues on Sniff Island. Go to a dock cottage by the water and ask the captain to take you across.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.thu: A dock cottage on a Deep Guh Sea in the Guhmension
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4_bot: Lesson 1: hold the sniff key and walk to where the orange meter swings the hardest. Swinging all the way? Then just hold down your left mouse button: as a dog you do not break the block, you dig.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.4_b: The meadow, right by Master Trufflenose
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4_flu: Lesson 2: the master's whistle lies farther off in the meadow, by the hedge on the west side. Blue is a thing. Dig it up.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4_bij: Lesson 3: not everything lies under the ground. Stand right by the bee oak on the west side of the meadow and keep sniffing.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.4_b: The big oak on the west side of the meadow
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.4_ter: Found it! Go back to Master Trufflenose.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.6_zoe: Sniff out what the villagers have mislaid (your buddy points the way) and dig it up. Can't remember where? Just ask them again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.waar.6_z: Sniffville, the meadow and the beach
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.6_bre: You've found something! Bring it back to whoever was missing it.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.7_bez: The exam is on: sniff out the four hidden scents, one of each color. There's no such thing as failing.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.7_dip: Found all four! Get your diploma from Master Trufflenose.
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.nu.8_snu: Between the stones by the little tree you smell something strange. Sniff and dig!
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.0: Look for a dock cottage by the water
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.1: Go to the sickbed, choose your dog and set sail
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.2: Walk to the village and talk to Wendy Wagtail
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.3: Talk to Doctor Plasterpaw (the house with the red cross)
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.4: Talk to Master Trufflenose in the meadow
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.4_b: Lesson 1: sniff out the chew bone. To dig: hold down your left mouse button
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.4_f: Lesson 2: sniff out the whistle (blue, farther off)
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.4_b: Lesson 3: sniff by the bee oak (green, no digging)
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.5: Have a look by the well in the square
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.6: Ask the villagers what they've mislaid
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.6_z: Sniff out what the villagers have mislaid
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.7: Talk to Master Trufflenose about your exam
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.7_b: Exam: sniff out the four scents
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.7_d: Get your diploma from Master Trufflenose
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.8: Go to your buddy's little tree
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.8_s: Sniff and dig by the little tree
gui.guhs.verhalen.snuffeleiland.kort.thu: Go back to Sniff Island (dock cottage)
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.feest_zo: Shh, the Lantern Feast is about to begin. Come and watch, nyeg!
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.hint.ziekbed: Little Wobble is in bed in the cottage. Hurry and have a look
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.hint.kapitein: Talk to Captain Saltsnout at the end of the dock
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.1: There you are. Now don't be alarmed: Wobble is as hot as a little stove and won't even touch a nibble. And a pup that turns its nose up at a nibble... that's the sniffle fever, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.2: Only one thing helps against that: the healing flower. It only grows on Sniff Island, far away across the Deep Guh Sea.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.3: Your papa went looking for it weeks ago. Weeks! And since then: not a letter, not a woof, nothing. I'm worried about old Wanderpaw.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.4: Whimper... I want Papa... and a nibble... but Papa first...
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.5: Listen closely. Here in the Guhmension you look the way you always do. But on Sniff Island you're simply who you are: a dog, just like Wobble and your papa. And only a dog with a good nose will find that flower.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.ziekbed.6: I'll watch over Wobble, day and night. But somebody has to go and fetch the flower. And look for Papa.
gui.guhs.snuffelsteiger.optie.nadenken: I need to think it over for a bit
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.buur.dapper: Brave, nyeg! Captain Saltsnout is moored at the dock with The Wet Nose. He's the only one who knows the way to the island.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.buur.ga: Off you go to the captain, at the end of the dock. I'll stay with Wobble.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.buur.terug: %s! Wobble is sleeping restlessly, but I'm right here. Do you have the flower yet? Not yet? Then quickly back to the island, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.buur.spoor: A trace of Papa? Really truly, %s? Then it's sure to turn out fine. Wobble is dreaming of it already, just look.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.pup.ga: Whimper... are you going to fetch Papa? And the flower? And... a nibble for the road?
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.pup.spoor: Yip! %s, did you smell Papa? Really really? Then I'll get better soon. Nyeg...
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.eerst: Ahoy. What a fright, eh, with the little one. Go and look in at the sickbed first, in the cottage. I'm not going anywhere, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.wie: To Sniff Island? That's a wild crossing, landlubber. And only dogs walk around there: the moment you set paw ashore, you're one yourself again. So tell me: which dog are you, under that coat? And which buddy is coming along with you?
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.gekoz: A %s called %s, with %s as a buddy. Well, well, nyeg! Just say the word when you're ready to set sail.
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.klaar: Everything on board, %s? There's rough weather coming, I can feel it in my whiskers. Shall we set sail?
gui.guhs.snuffelsteiger.optie.andere_hon: I'd like a different dog or a different buddy after all
quest.guhs.snuffelsteiger.kapitein.weer: Ahoy, %s! The Wet Nose is ready. Back to Sniff Island? This time you stay in the boat, deal?
gui.guhs.snuffelsteiger.optie.blijven: I'll stay here a little longer
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.avond: It's the evening of the Lantern Feast. The whole little village is out on the dock.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.ahoi: Ahoy! Lanterns lit, bones on the table. Let's feast, nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.bed: Little Wobble should have been in bed ages ago. But a feast is a feast...
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.mandje: Wobble! You belong in your basket!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.gloeit: Oh no! Wobble is burning up!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_feest.binnen: Quick, inside. Into bed with you!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.los: All paws on deck? Then we cast off. On to Sniff Island, nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.uit: And so you set sail, out onto the pink Guh Sea. For Wobble. And for Papa.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.luch: See that dark sky over there? I don't like it. Not one bit, nyeg.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.golv: Hold on tight! Waves as tall as a Guh House!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.teru: This is getting too wild! I'm turning back. We'll try again tomorrow.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.nee: Tomorrow is too late for Wobble! Then I'll swim!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.land: Landlubber! Come back! ... Nyeg. That's a brave one. Or plain bonkers.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_overtocht.zwar: The waves grow taller and taller... and then everything goes black.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_vaart.weer: Cast off those lines! And mind: no jumping overboard this time, nyeg.
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_thuiskomst.daa: There they are! Welcome home, nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffelsteiger_thuiskomst.thu: Safe at the dock, landlubber. The island isn't going anywhere.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_snuffeleilan: Here and there on the &9Deep Guh Sea&r in the &dGuhmension&r stands a &fdock cottage&r full of paper lanterns. That's where the Lantern Feast is... but your little brother or sister, &6Little Wobble&r, flomps to the floor. Your &6Super Compass&r (My Story) shows the way.

&6Mrs. Basket&r tells you at the sickbed: Papa has been gone for weeks, looking for the &dhealing flower&r. You're going after him! With &6Captain Saltsnout&r, choose your &fdog&r (breed, coat and name) and the &abuddy&r who comes along, and set sail on The Wet Nose. Nyeg, what waves...
You wake up on the beach of &bSniff Island&r, and you have... pawsies?! On the island you're a dog. &6Wendy Wagtail&r takes you to Sniffville. Your own things are waiting safely for you at home.
The old village doctor is sure of it: you'll only find the healing flower with a &freal sniff nose&r. For that you have to go to the meadow.

&6Master Trufflenose&r teaches you to sniff: hold the sniff key and your nose goes to the ground. The &fscent meter&r swings harder the closer you get, with a color for each kind of scent. Right on the spot, you dig it up.
A bucket topples over and nobody sees why. Only you can see it: a naughty &aforest sprite&r! It becomes your buddy, and from now on it shows you the way to scents.

The baker, the fisher, the teacher, Granny, the gardener and Little Droolball have each mislaid something. Ask about it, sniff it out and bring it back! With every good deed you learn a scent and your buddy's &alittle tree&r grows a bit. Four is enough.
Time for your exam with Master Trufflenose. There's no such thing as failing: your nose may take as long as it likes. Then you're a real &6Sniff Pup&r (rank 1 of 5).

By the little tree you smell something familiar... Papa was here! It doesn't solve anything yet, but now you know where to look. You get the &8Guhstation&r: with it you can go back to the island whenever you like. To be continued, nyeg!
